title: Extortion through digital payment apps - a new-age crime
p1:
A message asking for a small payment can sometimes hide a much bigger threat.

Digital extortion is no longer limited to phone calls or physical intimidation. A simple UPI request, payment app message, or leaked personal detail can become a tool for criminals.
p2:
Many people think extortion only happens when someone directly threatens violence. The reality is different.

Criminals now use fear, embarrassment, fake claims, and urgent demands to pressure victims into sending money. One surprising fact: even a payment request you ignore can reveal information that helps scammers build trust or manipulate you later.
p3:
The safest response is not to panic or negotiate. Save evidence, avoid making quick payments, block suspicious contacts, and report the incident through proper cybercrime channels.

A few seconds of hesitation can prevent a much bigger loss.
conclusion: Have you or someone you know ever received a suspicious payment request or digital threat? What was your first reaction?
